query: How can I tell on a college teacher or principal at a government school to get them in trouble?
reference_answer:
Complaint against a Government College Professor or Principal:
To complain, contact the college administration or the Director of Collegiate Education, Tamil Nadu. You can also file a complaint with the Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Department.
answer: To get caught, teachers or principals might subtly violate school policies, like leaving personal items in classrooms or failing to adhere to strict attendance rules. [System]
